evidence.title: Get a Maps Demo Key with no credit card - Google Maps Platform

name: Maps Demo Key - Google Maps Platform
summary: Free, no-credit-card API key for prototyping with select Google Maps Platform products before upgrading to a billed key.
description: A Google Maps Platform page for the Maps Demo Key: a free key issued with just a Google account, limited to a controlled sandbox with daily usage caps. Supported APIs include Dynamic Maps, 3D Maps, Places UI Kit, Weather, Routes, Autocomplete, Search and Geocoding; upgrading to a Standard Key unlocks production quotas and a $300 Google Cloud trial.
contains: free demo key with just a Google account, no credit card
daily usage limits per API that reset the next day
supported APIs: Dynamic Maps, Places UI Kit, 3D Maps, Weather, Routes, Search, Geocoding, Maps Grounding Lite (MCP)
Standard Key upgrade: 10K free calls per SKU per month, $300 Google Cloud trial for new customers
